CONSOLE_SERVER_VALID_CONFIG.desc: Configure valid console-server ports, groups, users, and mappings.

CONSOLE_SERVER_VALID_DEFAULTED_PORT.desc: Configure a console-server port with only its key and rely on YANG defaults.

CONSOLE_SERVER_INVALID_BAUDRATE.desc: Configure a console-server port with an unsupported baudrate.

CONSOLE_SERVER_EMPTY_LABEL.desc: Configure an explicitly empty console-server port label.

CONSOLE_SERVER_LONG_LABEL.desc: Configure a console-server label longer than 16 characters.

CONSOLE_SERVER_DUPLICATE_LABEL.desc: Configure the same stored label on two console-server ports.

CONSOLE_SERVER_USER_GROUP_MISSING_GROUP.desc: Reference a nonexistent group from a user-group mapping.
